scope: affine pure-TET P1 charge self diagonals only

quantity.diagonal: raw physical G_ii; volume m^5, surface m^3
quantity.scale: sqrt(G_ii), compared to independent CPU charge_sigma
quantity.parity_error: max over all 13 charges of abs(GPU_i-CPU_i)/abs(CPU_i), separately for each of six geometries

backend_port_proposal.rationale: Proposed FP64 port guard with margin over observed host shared-arithmetic error about 2e-15. New GPU results are not yet available. This is empirical, not a theorem or an adopted tolerance.
backend_port_proposal.reference: production CPU ChargeGram constructor/entry and charge_sigma; shared primitive potentials explicitly disclosed
backend_port_proposal.failure: missing/incomplete case, nonfinite/nonpositive output, provider/source/hash mismatch, failed lifetime guard, or an approved limit exceeded blocks acceptance

formulation_reference.required: independent integral evaluation without shared TriPotential/TriMoment1, or an approved cited analytic reference with symbolic verification
formulation_reference.deferred_reason: The existing adjacent-entry brute-force study is not a validated self-entry oracle. Direct same-node point clouds or dropping coincident nodes are not acceptable substitutes. No new reference method or citation is certified here.

convergence_proposal.axis: outer integration rule at fixed FE order 1 and fixed geometry
convergence_proposal.note: Orders 3 and 4 use the same production symmetric rule and cannot be counted as two levels. This is quadrature convergence, not FE p-convergence. P2 is unsupported.
convergence_proposal.reference_error_norm: per-charge relative self-energy error against the independently qualified reference, then category-wise maximum
convergence_proposal.plateau_policy: unexplained saturation blocks acceptance; no waiver is implemented
convergence_proposal.status: pending reference, theory, thresholds and user approval; not executed

linear_solver_residual.status: not applicable to this standalone constructor; no solve is performed
linear_solver_residual.record_schema_resolution: Existing adoption schema requires residual fields. Resolve applicability with schema owner/user before creating a record, or bind adoption to a future actual production solve with its measured residual. Never fill invented zero residuals.
